row: Welcome to our channel where we share our daily life as a veterinary couple. From our job routine to our travels, we give you an inside look at our daily vlogs and special moments. Follow us as we visit farms, share our knowledge and experience in the veterinary field, and give you a glimpse into our personal lives. Whether you're interested in veterinary medicine or just love watching vlogs, we hope you'll enjoy our channel and join us on this journey
